item.title: RT: 我的同事@LizAnnSonders 和@KevRGordon 称之为“鸭子市场”。今年的大部分时间里，尽管
item.description:
我的同事@LizAnnSonders 和@KevRGordon 称之为“鸭子市场”。今年的大部分时间里，尽管股市大幅下跌，标准普尔 500 指数却显得相当平静。

最近，你可以从岸边看到海浪。标准普尔 500 指数上周收盘较历史纪录低 11.6%。科技股引领了周一的上涨，然后今天早上拉低了标普 500 指数。

这张图表中的内容比我通常显示的要多，但首先是能源和航空公司。当春季油价飙升时，能源股领涨，而航空公司则陷入困境。随着 11 月份油价下跌，他们交换了位置。

然后看筹码。即使在周一上涨 15% 后，过去一个月半导体股票仍落后标准普尔 500 指数近 8 个百分点。当我听到关于人工智能获胜者的自信预测时，这让我犹豫不决。我相信人工智能将改变企业的运营方式，但我对哪些股票将引领这一趋势不太有信心。这是我们青睐广泛股票投资的原因之一。

My colleagues @LizAnnSonders and @KevRGordon call it a “duck market.” For much of this year, the S&P 500 looked fairly calm even as stocks were paddling hard underneath.

Lately, you can see the chop from shore. The S&P 500 ended last week 11.6% below its record. Tech led Monday’s rally and then pulled the S&P 500 lower this morning.

There’s more in this chart than I usually show, but start with energy and airlines. When oil prices surged in the spring, energy stocks led and airlines struggled. As oil eased in November, they traded places.

Then look at chips. Even after Monday’s 15% jump, semiconductor stocks still trailed the S&P 500 by nearly 8 percentage points over the past month. That’s what gives me pause when I hear a confident prediction about the winners from AI. I believe that AI will change how businesses operate but I’m less confident about which stocks will lead along the way. That’s one reason we favor broad equity exposure.

item.description:

item.title: 昨天的大部分走势实际上是在周五收盘和周一开盘之间市场休市时发生的；过去10年都是如
item.description:
昨天的大部分走势实际上是在周五收盘和周一开盘之间市场休市时发生的；过去10年都是如此，美国股市休市时标准普尔500指数的累计表现高于开市时；最近的抛售更加不平衡，大部分下跌发生在交易时间内，而隔夜走势却持续存在
@SPDJIndices

Most of yesterday’s move actually came when market was closed between Friday’s close and Monday’s open; this has been true over past 10 years, during which cumulative performance of S&P 500 while U.S. equity market was closed was higher than when it was open; recent sell-off has been more lopsided still, with most of decline happening during trading hours while overnight moves held up
@SPDJIndices
